newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Abacus forecast raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Abacus forecast raised.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it raised its 1997 earnings estimate for Abacus Direct Corp to $0.55/shr from $0.50/shr and revenue forecast to $25.1 million from $24.7 million after the company reported Q4 earnings on Thursday.
-- Abacus said it earned $0.12/shr in Q4, beating the investment brokerage's forecast of $0.09/shr.

-- In a statement, H & Q said Abacus "continues to represent an exciting information services company -- one that combines unique database and information system capabilities with tremendous industry expertise and a strong services offering." H & Q maintains a buy rating on the stock.
